# The Companion's NativeRegions (NativeRegionsTest.java) registers the
# `region:` rows below, copies one frame with the `capture:` fields, and must
# read exactly `line:`. The host's parseRegionRead
# (packages/play/test/companion-region-read.test.ts) must decode that line,
# behind `OK ` and with a snapshotNs, to the same regions and pixels. The
# frame's pixel (x, y) is (x << 12) | y, so each sample names its own native
# coordinates: sample i of a region is (x + (i % cols) * step,
# y + floor(i / cols) * step).
